items.claim: Taron Growth came into the UFC very inexperienced and had to develop on the job.
items.quote: He came into the UFC super green and had to develop on the job.

items.claim: Vicente Luque has not been the same since suffering a brain bleed.
items.quote: Vicente Luke. Obviously, we know about the brain bleed and we know that he hasn't been the same since.

items.claim: Vicente Luque still possesses great finishing danger if opponents do not present adversity.
items.quote: If Vicente Luke can catch you, he can still hurt you. If you put your head into a choke, he can still choke you out.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando has a significant 7-inch reach advantage.
items.quote: He's got a significant 7 in reach advantage at 81 and a half inches of reach.

items.claim: Neil Magny is experiencing declining durability and skills due to age, wear, and tear.
items.quote: I just think we're finally getting to that point where all the damage, all the wear and tear, all the wars... are going to take their toll on a guy like Magny.
